# index.html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Heist Duo - Stealth Puzzle Game</title>
<meta name="description" content="Heist Duo: sneak past cameras and guards, hack doors and steal the loot across 50 stealth levels.">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#0b1020">
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<style>
:root{box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);--bg:#0b1020;--gold:#ffb300}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}
html,body{height:100%;margin:0;background:var(--bg);overflow:hidden;font-family:system-ui,sans-serif;color:#fff;-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none;touch-action:none}
canvas{display:block;position:fixed;left:0;top:0;width:100vw;height:100vh;height:100dvh}
.scr{position:fixed;inset:0;display:none;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;padding:16px;z-index:5;gap:10px;overflow:auto}
.dim{background:rgba(6,9,18,.86)}
h1{margin:0;font-size:clamp(34px,9vw,84px);letter-spacing:4px;color:#ffd54f;text-shadow:0 0 12px #ff9800,0 0 30px #e65100,0 4px 0 #7a3a00}
h2{margin:0;font-size:clamp(20px,4vw,34px);color:#ffd54f}
.sub{opacity:.85;font-size:clamp(13px,2.4vw,18px);max-width:620px;line-height:1.45}
.bt{font:800 clamp(15px,2.6vw,22px) system-ui;color:#2b1700;background:linear-gradient(#ffd54f,#ff9800);border:0;border-radius:14px;padding:12px 28px;min-width:min(260px,70vw);box-shadow:0 5px 0 #a35a00,0 8px 16px #0008;cursor:pointer}
.bt:active{transform:translateY(3px);box-shadow:0 2px 0 #a35a00}
.bt.g{background:linear-gradient(#5c6bc0,#3949ab);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 5px 0 #1a237e,0 8px 16px #0008}
.row{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center}
#grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(60px,110px));gap:10px}
.lv{background:#1c2547;border:2px solid #3949ab;border-radius:12px;padding:8px 4px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:800}
.lv small{display:block;font-weight:600;font-size:10px;opacity:.7;min-height:12px}.lv i{font-style:normal;color:#ffd54f;font-size:13px;display:block}
.lv.lock{opacity:.4;pointer-events:none}
.how{text-align:left;max-width:640px;font-size:clamp(13px,2.2vw,16px);line-height:1.5;background:#141b34;border-radius:14px;padding:14px 18px;border:1px solid #2c3770}
.how b{color:#ffd54f}
#hud{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);display:none;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:6px 10px;background:linear-gradient(#0b1020,#0b1020cc);font-weight:700;font-size:14px;z-index:4}
#hud button{background:#24304d;color:#fff;border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:4px 12px;font-size:16px}
#hint{position:fixed;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);bottom:calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));max-width:90vw;display:none;background:#000b;border:1px solid #ffb30088;border-radius:12px;padding:8px 16px;font-size:clamp(12px,2.2vw,16px);font-weight:700;z-index:4;pointer-events:none;text-align:center}
#sel,#shop{justify-content:flex-start;padding-top:calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px))}
#sgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(96px,1fr));gap:10px;width:min(560px,96vw)}
.sk canvas{width:64px;height:64px;display:block;margin:0 auto}.sk.on{border-color:#69f0ae;background:#16382a}.sk i{font-size:12px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c"></canvas>
<div id="hud"><button data-a="pause">⏸</button><span id="h1"></span><span id="h2"></span><span id="h3"></span></div>
<div id="hint"></div>
<div id="home" class="scr" style="justify-content:flex-start;padding-top:6vh">
 <h1>HEIST DUO</h1><div class="sub" style="font-size:clamp(14px,2.6vw,22px);letter-spacing:2px">EK CHOR. EK PLAN. KOI GALTI NAHI.</div>
 <div style="flex:1;min-height:20px"></div>
 <button class="bt" data-a="play">▶ PLAY</button>
 <div class="row"><button class="bt g" data-a="levels" style="min-width:120px">LEVELS</button><button class="bt g" data-a="shop" id="shopb" style="min-width:120px">🛒 SHOP</button><button class="bt g" data-a="how" style="min-width:120px">HOW TO PLAY</button><button class="bt g" data-a="sound" id="snd" style="min-width:120px">SOUND</button></div>
 <div class="sub" style="font-size:12px;opacity:.6">Best in landscape · Move, hack, steal</div>
</div>
<div id="sel" class="scr dim"><h2>LEVELS</h2><div id="grid"></div><button class="bt g" data-a="home" style="min-width:120px">← HOME</button></div>
<div id="how" class="scr dim"><h2>KAISE KHELEIN</h2><div class="how">
 Tum ek <b>chor</b> ho. Saara 💰 loot uthao aur green <b>EXIT</b> tak pahucho, bina pakde.<br>
 <b>🕹 CHALNA:</b> phone par neeche-baayein angootha rakho (joystick). PC par <b>WASD</b>.<br>
 <b>🖐 HACK KARNA:</b> screen par <b>TAP</b> (PC par click):<br>
 &nbsp;• 📹 <b>camera</b> par tap = 5 second ke liye band (phir 9 sec rukna padta hai)<br>
 &nbsp;• 🟠 <b>door</b> par tap = kuch second ke liye khulta hai<br>
 <b>⚠ Khatre:</b> camera ka laal cone aur guard ka peela cone. Inme dikhe toh <b>jaan</b> gayi (3 jaan).<br>
 <b>⭐ Stars:</b> bina pakde = 3★, ek baar pakde = 2★, zyada = 1★.<br>
 <b>🪙 Coins:</b> level clear karo, coins kamao, aur 🛒 SHOP se naye skins kharido.<br>
 <b>🧠 Plan banao!</b> Pehle camera band karo, phir andar jao.</div>
 <button class="bt g" data-a="home" style="min-width:120px">← HOME</button></div>
<div id="shop" class="scr dim"><h2>🛒 SKINS</h2><div class="sub" id="coinz"></div><canvas id="spv" width="160" height="160" style="width:130px;height:130px;background:#141b34;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid #2c3770"></canvas><div class="sub" id="sinfo" style="min-height:20px;font-weight:700"></div><button class="bt" id="sbtn" data-a="sact" style="min-width:160px"></button><div id="sgrid"></div><button class="bt g" data-a="home" style="min-width:120px">← HOME</button></div>
<div id="card" class="scr dim"></div>

function genLevels(){
const P=['Bank','Neon','Jewel','Gold','Shadow','Laser','Diamond','Casino','Sky','Metro'],Q=['Run','Vault','Hall','Rush','Raid','Tower','Lock','Dome'],TP=['Rooms','Pillars','Zigzag','Ring','Cross'],
TIP=['Kai kamre aur doors. Door kholo aur timing se nikal jao.','Pillars ke peeche chhupo. Beech ki deewar ke doors tap karke kholo.','Zigzag manzilein. for(let i=10;i<50;i++){
let s=i*7919+13;const rnd=()=>(s=s*16807%2147483647)/2147483647,ri=(a,b)=>a+Math.floor(rnd()*(b-a+1));rnd();rnd();
const k=(i-10)/39,ty=i%5,C=ri(22,26),R=ri(12,15),g=[];
for(let y=0;y<R;y++){g.push([]);for(let x=0;x<C;x++)g[y].push(y&&x&&y<R-1&&x<C-1?'.':'#');}
const ok0=(x,y)=>x>0&&y>0&&x<C-1&&y<R-1,wall=(x,y)=>{if(ok0(x,y))g[y][x]='#';},door=(x,y)=>{if(ok0(x,y))g[y][x]='D';};
if(ty===0){const nc=k>.5?4:3,nr=(k>.6&&R>=14)?3:2,xs=[],ys=[];
 for(let a=1;a<nc;a++)xs.push(Math.round(C*a/nc));for(let a=1;a<nr;a++)ys.push(Math.round(R*a/nr));
 xs.forEach(x=>{for(let y=1;y<R-1;y++)wall(x,y);});ys.forEach(y=>{for(let x=1;x<C-1;x++)wall(x,y);});
 const bx=[0,...xs,C-1],by=[0,...ys,R-1];
 xs.forEach(x=>{for(let j=0;j<by.length-1;j++)door(x,ri(by[j]+1,by[j+1]-1));});
 ys.forEach(y=>{for(let j=0;j<bx.length-1;j++)door(ri(bx[j]+1,bx[j+1]-1),y);});}
else if(ty===1){const wx=Math.round(C/2),m=R>>1;for(let y=1;y<R-1;y++)wall(wx,y);door(wx,ri(1,m));door(wx,ri(m+2,R-2));
 for(let x=3;x+1<=C-3;x+=4)for(let y=3;y+1<=R-3;y+=3)if(!(x+1>=wx-1&&x<=wx+1)){wall(x,y);wall(x+1,y);wall(x,y+1);wall(x+1,y+1);}}
else if(ty===2){[Math.round(R/3),Math.round(2*R/3)].forEach((y,j)=>{for(let x=1;x<C-1;x++)wall(x,y);const gx=j%2?1:C-3;for(let a=0;a<2;a++)g[y][gx+a]='.';door(ri(6,C-7),y);});}
else if(ty===3){const x0=4,x1=C-5,y0=3,y1=R-4;for(let x=x0;x<=x1;x++){wall(x,y0);wall(x,y1);}for(let y=y0;y<=y1;y++){wall(x0,y);wall(x1,y);}
 const sd=[()=>door(ri(x0+1,x1-1),y0),()=>door(ri(x0+1,x1-1),y1),()=>door(x0,ri(y0+1,y1-1)),()=>door(x1,ri(y0+1,y1-1))],a=ri(0,3);sd[a]();sd[(a+2)%4]();
 if(k>.3){const mx=Math.round((x0+x1)/2),my=Math.round((y0+y1)/2);wall(mx,my);wall(mx+1,my);}}
else{const cx=C>>1,cy=R>>1;
 for(let y=1;y<=cy-2;y++){wall(cx-2,y);wall(cx+2,y);}for(let y=cy+2;y<R-1;y++){wall(cx-2,y);wall(cx+2,y);}
 for(let x=1;x<=cx-2;x++){wall(x,cy-2);wall(x,cy+2);}for(let x=cx+2;x<C-1;x++){wall(x,cy-2);wall(x,cy+2);}
 [[cx-2,1,cy-3],[cx+2,1,cy-3],[cx-2,cy+3,R-2],[cx+2,cy+3,R-2]].forEach(r=>door(r[0],ri(r[1],r[2])));
 if(k<.6)[[1,cx-3,cy-2],[cx+3,C-2,cy-2],[1,cx-3,cy+2],[cx+3,C-2,cy+2]].forEach(r=>door(ri(r[0],r[1]),r[2]));}
let S=null;for(let y=1;y<R-1&&!S;y++)for(let x=1;x<C-1;x++)if(g[y][x]==='.'){S=[x,y];break;}
const D=g.map(r=>r.map(()=>-1)),q=[S];D[S[1]][S[0]]=0;
for(let h=0;h<q.length;h++){const[x,y]=q[h];[[1,0],[-1,0],[0,1],[0,-1]].forEach(([a,b])=>{const X=x+a,Y=y+b;if(g[Y][X]!=='#'&&D[Y][X]<0){D[Y][X]=D[y][x]+1;q.push([X,Y]);}});}
let E=S;q.forEach(([x,y])=>{if(g[y][x]==='.'&&D[y][x]>D[E[1]][E[0]])E=[x,y];});
const nl=3+Math.floor(k*6),Ls=[],fl=q.filter(([x,y])=>g[y][x]==='.'&&D[y][x]>5&&(x!==E[0]||y!==E[1]));
for(let t=0;t<300&&Ls.length<nl&&fl.length;t++){const p=fl[ri(0,fl.length-1)];if(Ls.every(o=>Math.abs(o[0]-p[0])+Math.abs(o[1]-p[1])>4))Ls.push(p);}
const fl2=q.filter(([x,y])=>g[y][x]==='.'&&Math.hypot(x-S[0],y-S[1])>5),ng=Math.min(6,Math.floor(.5+k*5.5)),nc2=Math.min(6,Math.floor(1+k*5)),Gs=[],Cs=[],lim=4+Math.round(k*4);
for(let t=0;t<400&&Gs.length<ng&&fl2.length;t++){const[x,y]=fl2[ri(0,fl2.length-1)],hz=rnd()<.5,dx=hz?1:0,dy=hz?0:1,ok=(a,b)=>g[b][a]==='.'&&g[b+dx][a+dy]==='.'&&g[b-dx][a-dy]==='.';
 if(!ok(x,y))continue;let a=x,b=y,n1=0,c=x,d=y,n2=0;while(n1<lim&&ok(a+dx,b+dy)){a+=dx;b+=dy;n1++;}while(n2<lim&&ok(c-dx,d-dy)){c-=dx;d-=dy;n2++;}
 if(n1+n2>=3)Gs.push([[c+.5,d+.5],[a+.5,b+.5]]);}
const wc=fl2.filter(([x,y])=>[[1,0],[-1,0],[0,1],[0,-1]].some(([a,b])=>g[y+b][x+a]==='#'));
for(let t=0;t<400&&Cs.length<nc2&&wc.length;t++){const[x,y]=wc[ri(0,wc.length-1)];if(Cs.some(o=>Math.hypot(o[0]-x-.5,o[1]-y-.5)<4))continue;
 let ba=0,bl=-1;for(let r=0;r<8;r++){const an=r*Math.PI/4;let l=0;while(l<12&&g[Math.floor(y+.5+Math.sin(an)*l)][Math.floor(x+.5+Math.cos(an)*l)]!=='#')l+=.3;if(l>bl){bl=l;ba=an;}}
 Cs.push([x+.5,y+.5,ba,.4+rnd()*.7,1+rnd()*.5,Math.max(5,Math.min(8,bl))]);}
Ls.forEach(([x,y])=>g[y][x]='L');g[E[1]][E[0]]='E';g[S[1]][S[0]]='S';
LV.push({n:P[(i-10)%10]+' '+Q[((i-10)/10|0)*2+(i%2)]+' · '+TP[ty],m:g.map(r=>r.join('')),c:Cs,g:Gs,d:Math.max(2.6,4.3-k*1.7),cs:1+k*.9,gs:1.8+k*1.5,tip:TIP[ty]});}
LV[49].n='LEGEND HEIST';LV[49].tip='Aakhri level! Sabse bada heist.';}
genLevels();

let ac,master,muted=false,musicOn=false,ms=0,nextT=0;try{muted=localStorage.getItem('hd_mute')==='1';}catch(e){}
function aInit(){if(!ac){const A=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;if(!A)return;ac=new A();master=ac.createGain();master.gain.value=muted?0:1;master.connect(ac.destination);}if(ac.state==='suspended')ac.resume();}
function tone(f,t0,d,ty,v,to){if(!ac)return;const o=ac.createOscillator(),g=ac.createGain();o.type=ty;o.frequency.setValueAtTime(f,t0);if(to)o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(to,t0+d);g.gain.setValueAtTime(v,t0);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,t0+d);o.connect(g);g.connect(master);o.start(t0);o.stop(t0+d+.05);}
const S={click(){tone(700,ac.currentTime,.05,'square',.06);},step(){tone(95,ac.currentTime,.05,'triangle',.05,60);},loot(){const n=ac.currentTime;tone(1000,n,.08,'square',.09);tone(1500,n+.07,.15,'square',.09);},
hack(){const n=ac.currentTime;tone(1400,n,.07,'square',.08,500);tone(600,n+.08,.07,'square',.08,1400);tone(900,n+.16,.12,'square',.08,300);},door(){const n=ac.currentTime;tone(160,n,.25,'sawtooth',.1,320);tone(80,n,.12,'sine',.2,50);},
alarm(){const n=ac.currentTime;for(let i=0;i<4;i++)tone(i%2?500:800,n+i*.15,.15,'sawtooth',.14);},start(){const n=ac.currentTime;tone(330,n,.1,'triangle',.15);tone(440,n+.1,.1,'triangle',.15);tone(660,n+.2,.2,'triangle',.15);},
win(){const n=ac.currentTime;[523,659,784,1047].forEach((f,i)=>tone(f,n+i*.12,.25,'square',.1));},over(){const n=ac.currentTime;tone(300,n,.8,'sawtooth',.2,40);tone(90,n,.6,'sine',.35,30);}};
const play=n=>{if(ac&&!muted)S[n]();};
function music(){if(!ac||!musicOn||muted)return;const r=[55,55,65.4,49],d=.34-.02*Math.min(li,8);if(nextT<ac.currentTime)nextT=ac.currentTime;
 while(nextT<ac.currentTime+.25){const k=r[Math.floor(ms/8)%4];if(ms%2===0)tone(k,nextT,d*1.8,'triangle',.22);if(ms%4===2)tone(2200,nextT,.03,'square',.025);ms++;nextT+=d;}}
function mute(){muted=!muted;if(master)master.gain.value=muted?0:1;try{localStorage.setItem('hd_mute',muted?'1':'0');}catch(e){}$('snd').textContent=muted?'SOUND OFF':'SOUND ON';}

// ---------- grid logic ----------
const tile=(x,y)=>{const a=Math.floor(x),b=Math.floor(y);return(a<0||b<0||a>=C||b>=R)?'#':MAP[b][a];};
const solid=(x,y)=>{const c=tile(x,y);return c==='#'||(c==='D'&&!((doorT[Math.floor(x)+','+Math.floor(y)]||0)>t));};
function los(a,b,c,d){const n=Math.ceil(Math.hypot(c-a,d-b)/.15);for(let i=1;i<n;i++)if(solid(a+(c-a)*i/n,b+(d-b)*i/n))return false;return true;}
function ray(x,y,a,len){for(let d=0;d<len;d+=.1)if(solid(x+Math.cos(a)*d,y+Math.sin(a)*d))return d;return len;}
function seen(x,y,a,len,hf){const dx=th.x-x,dy=th.y-y;if(Math.hypot(dx,dy)>len)return false;const an=Math.atan2(dy,dx),df=Math.atan2(Math.sin(an-a),Math.cos(an-a));return Math.abs(df)<hf&&los(x,y,th.x,th.y);}
const canGo=(x,y)=>!solid(x-.3,y-.3)&&!solid(x+.3,y-.3)&&!solid(x-.3,y+.3)&&!solid(x+.3,y+.3);

// ---------- screens ----------
const SC=['home','sel','how','card','shop'];
function show(id){SC.forEach(s=>$(s).style.display=s===id?'flex':'none');$('hud').style.display=$('hint').style.display='none';}
function hideAll(){SC.forEach(s=>$(s).style.display='none');$('hud').style.display='flex';$('hint').style.display='block';}
function card(h){$('card').innerHTML=h;show('card');}
function stars(n){return '★'.repeat(n)+'☆'.repeat(3-n);}
const TEST=false;function buildSel(){$('grid').innerHTML=LV.map((l,i)=>`<div class="lv ${TEST||i<prog.u?'':'lock'}" data-a="pick" data-i="${i}" style="border-color:${['#3949ab','#00897b','#f9a825','#ef6c00','#d32f2f'][i/10|0]}">${TEST||i<prog.u?i+1:'🔒'}<small>${l.n}</small><i>${stars(prog.s[i]||0)}</i></div>`).join('');}
function go(i){if(i>=LV.length){st='home';musicOn=false;card('<h1>🏆</h1><h2>SAARE LEVELS POORE!</h2><div class="sub">Tum asli Heist Duo ho. Dosto ko challenge karo!</div><button class="bt" data-a="home">HOME</button>');return;}
 li=i;L=LV[i];MAP=L.m;R=MAP.length;C=MAP[0].length;resize(true);lives=3;t=0;inv=1.5;flash=shake=0;th={x:1.5,y:1.5};loot=new Set();doorT={};parts=[];hacked=doorUsed=false;
 MAP.forEach((r,y)=>[...r].forEach((ch,x)=>{if(ch==='S')th={x:x+.5,y:y+.5};if(ch==='L')loot.add(x+','+y);}));total=loot.size;
 cams=L.c.map((d,k)=>({x:d[0],y:d[1],b:d[2],r:d[3],sp:d[4]*L.cs,len:d[5],a:d[2],off:0,ready:0,ph:k}));
 guards=L.g.map(p=>({p,i:1,x:p[0][0],y:p[0][1],a:0,w:0}));
 st='intro';musicOn=false;
 card(`<div class="sub" style="letter-spacing:3px">LEVEL ${i+1} / ${LV.length}</div><h2>${L.n}</h2><div class="how"><b>🎯 Target:</b> ${total} 💰 loot uthao, phir green EXIT.<br><b>💡 Tip:</b> ${L.tip}<br>${i===0?'<b>🆕 Ye tutorial hai:</b> neeche hint bar step-by-step batayegi.':''}</div><button class="bt" data-a="start">START</button><button class="bt g" data-a="home" style="min-width:120px">HOME</button>`);}
function coinUI(){$('shopb').textContent='🛒 SHOP 🪙 '+prog.coins;}
let shopSel=null;
function buildShop(msg){if(shopSel===null)shopSel=prog.sk;const k=SK[shopSel],own=prog.own.includes(shopSel),eq=prog.sk===shopSel;$('coinz').textContent='Tumhare coins: 🪙 '+prog.coins;
 $('sgrid').innerHTML=SK.map((k,i)=>`<div class="lv sk ${shopSel===i?'on':''}" data-a="buy" data-i="${i}"><canvas width="80" height="80"></canvas>${k.n}<i>${prog.sk===i?'✔ EQUIPPED':prog.own.includes(i)?'OWNED':'🪙 '+k.p}</i></div>`).join('');
 $('sinfo').style.color=msg&&msg[0]==='❌'?'#ff8a80':'#fff';$('sinfo').textContent=msg||(k.n+(own?' · tumhare paas hai':' · 🪙 '+k.p));
 const bt=$('sbtn');bt.textContent=eq?'✔ EQUIPPED':own?'EQUIP':'BUY 🪙 '+k.p;bt.style.opacity=eq?.5:1;
 const o=ctx;document.querySelectorAll('#sgrid canvas').forEach((c,i)=>{ctx=c.getContext('2d');drawThief(40,46,6,1,SK[i]);});
 const p=$('spv');ctx=p.getContext('2d');ctx.clearRect(0,0,160,160);drawThief(80,88,12,1,k);ctx=o;}
const A={shop(){st='home';shopSel=null;buildShop();show('shop');},buy(b){shopSel=+b.dataset.i;buildShop();},sact(){const i=shopSel,k=SK[i];if(prog.own.includes(i)){prog.sk=i;save();buildShop('✔ Equip ho gaya!');return;}
 if(prog.coins<k.p){buildShop('❌ Not enough coins! Aur levels khelo.');return;}prog.coins-=k.p;prog.own.push(i);prog.sk=i;play('win');save();coinUI();buildShop('🎉 Kharid liya aur equip ho gaya!');},play(){go(Math.min(prog.u,LV.length)-1);},levels(){st='home';buildSel();show('sel');},how(){show('how');},home(){st='home';musicOn=false;coinUI();show('home');},sound:mute,
 start(){st='play';hideAll();play('start');musicOn=true;ms=0;if(ac)nextT=ac.currentTime+.05;},next(){go(li+1);},retry(){go(li);},resume(){st='play';hideAll();},
 pause(){if(st==='play'){st='pause';card('<h2>PAUSE</h2><button class="bt" data-a="resume">▶ RESUME</button><button class="bt g" data-a="retry">↻ RESTART</button><button class="bt g" data-a="home">HOME</button>');}},pick(b){go(+b.dataset.i);}};
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('[data-a]');if(!b)return;aInit();try{if(!document.fullscreenElement&&'ontouchstart' in window&&!window._fs&&(window._fs=1)&&document.documentElement.requestFullscreen)document.documentElement.requestFullscreen().then(()=>screen.orientation&&screen.orientation.lock&&screen.orientation.lock('landscape').catch(()=>{})).catch(()=>{});}catch(x){}play('click');A[b.dataset.a](b);});
function caught(why){lives--;flash=1;shake=1;th=Object.assign({},start0());inv=1.5;play('alarm');
 if(lives<=0){st='over';musicOn=false;play('over');card(`<h1 style="color:#ff5252">PAKDE GAYE!</h1><div class="sub">${why}</div><button class="bt" data-a="retry">↻ RETRY</button><button class="bt g" data-a="home">HOME</button>`);}}
const start0=()=>{for(let y=0;y<R;y++){const x=MAP[y].indexOf('S');if(x>=0)return{x:x+.5,y:y+.5};}return{x:1.5,y:1.5};};
function won(){const s=lives>=3?3:lives===2?2:1;prog.s[li]=Math.max(prog.s[li]||0,s);prog.u=Math.max(prog.u,Math.min(LV.length,li+2));cn=total*3+s*5+Math.floor(li/5)*2;prog.coins+=cn;save();coinUI();st='clear';musicOn=false;play('win');
 card(`<h2>LEVEL ${li+1} CLEAR!</h2><h1 style="font-size:clamp(34px,8vw,64px)">${stars(s)}</h1><div class="sub">Time: ${t.toFixed(0)}s · Jaan bachi: ${lives}<br>+${cn} 🪙 coins (total ${prog.coins})</div><button class="bt" data-a="next">${li+1<LV.length?'NEXT LEVEL ▶':'FINISH 🏆'}</button><div class="row"><button class="bt g" data-a="retry" style="min-width:120px">↻ REPLAY</button><button class="bt g" data-a="levels" style="min-width:120px">LEVELS</button></div>`);}

// ---------- input ----------
function hacker(px,py){const gx=(px-ox)/T,gy=(py-oy)/T;let b=null,bd=1.4;
 cams.forEach(c=>{const d=Math.hypot(c.x-gx,c.y-gy);if(d<bd&&c.ready<=t){bd=d;b=c;}});
 if(b){b.off=t+5;b.ready=t+9;hacked=true;play('hack');addP(b.x,b.y,'#00e5ff',10);return;}
 const x=Math.floor(gx),y=Math.floor(gy);let bk=null,bdd=1.2;
 for(let dy=-1;dy<=1;dy++)for(let dx=-1;dx<=1;dx++)if(tile(x+dx,y+dy)==='D'){const d=Math.hypot(x+dx+.5-gx,y+dy+.5-gy);if(d<bdd){bdd=d;bk=(x+dx)+','+(y+dy);}}
 if(bk){doorT[bk]=t+L.d;doorUsed=true;play('door');}}
cv.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{e.preventDefault();aInit();if(st!=='play')return;if(e.pointerType==='touch')touchUI=true;
 if(touchUI&&e.pointerType==='touch'&&!joy&&e.clientX<W*.42&&e.clientY>H*.4){joy={id:e.pointerId,cx:Math.max(T*2,Math.min(e.clientX,W*.4)),cy:Math.min(e.clientY,H-T*2),r:T*1.8,x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY};return;}
 hacker(e.clientX,e.clientY);});
addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(joy&&joy.id===e.pointerId){const dx=e.clientX-joy.cx,dy=e.clientY-joy.cy,m=Math.hypot(dx,dy),k=Math.min(1,joy.r/(m||1));joy.x=joy.cx+dx*k;joy.y=joy.cy+dy*k;}});
const up=e=>{if(joy&&joy.id===e.pointerId)joy=null;};addEventListener('pointerup',up);addEventListener('pointercancel',up);
addEventListener('keydown',e=>{keys[e.code]=true;if(e.code==='KeyM')mute();if((e.code==='Escape'||e.code==='KeyP')&&st==='play')A.pause();if(e.code.startsWith('Arrow')||e.code==='Space')e.preventDefault();});
addEventListener('keyup',e=>{keys[e.code]=false;});

// ---------- update ----------
function addP(x,y,c,n){for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const a=Math.random()*PI*2,s=.5+Math.random()*2;parts.push({x,y,vx:Math.cos(a)*s,vy:Math.sin(a)*s,l:.6+Math.random()*.4,c});}}
function update(dt){now+=dt;flash=Math.max(0,flash-dt*1.5);shake=Math.max(0,shake-dt*2);
 parts.forEach(p=>{p.x+=p.vx*dt;p.y+=p.vy*dt;p.l-=dt;});parts=parts.filter(p=>p.l>0);
 if(st!=='play')return;t+=dt;inv=Math.max(0,inv-dt);music();
 let vx=(keys.KeyD||keys.ArrowRight?1:0)-(keys.KeyA||keys.ArrowLeft?1:0),vy=(keys.KeyS||keys.ArrowDown?1:0)-(keys.KeyW||keys.ArrowUp?1:0);
 if(joy){const dx=joy.x-joy.cx,dy=joy.y-joy.cy,m=Math.hypot(dx,dy);if(m>joy.r*.2){vx+=dx/m;vy+=dy/m;}}
 const m=Math.hypot(vx,vy);
 if(m>0){vx/=m;vy/=m;if(vx)fdir=vx>0?1:-1;const s=4.2*dt;if(canGo(th.x+vx*s,th.y))th.x+=vx*s;if(canGo(th.x,th.y+vy*s))th.y+=vy*s;stepT+=dt;if(stepT>.28){stepT=0;play('step');}}
 loot.forEach(k=>{const[a,b]=k.split(',').map(Number);if(Math.hypot(a+.5-th.x,b+.5-th.y)<.6){loot.delete(k);play('loot');addP(a+.5,b+.5,'#ffd600',14);}});
 if(loot.size===0&&tile(th.x,th.y)==='E'){won();return;}
 for(const c of cams){c.a=c.b+c.r*Math.sin(t*c.sp+c.ph);if(c.off<=t&&inv<=0&&seen(c.x,c.y,c.a,c.len,.3)){caught('Camera ne dekh liya!');return;}}
 for(const g of guards){if(g.w>0)g.w-=dt;else{const tg=g.p[g.i],dx=tg[0]-g.x,dy=tg[1]-g.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
  if(d<.1){g.i=(g.i+1)%g.p.length;g.w=.7;}else{g.a=Math.atan2(dy,dx);const s=Math.min(d,L.gs*dt);g.x+=dx/d*s;g.y+=dy/d*s;}}
  if(inv<=0&&seen(g.x,g.y,g.a,3.8,.7)){caught('Guard ne pakad liya!');return;}}
}
function hint(){if(li===0)return loot.size?'🕹 Joystick (PC: WASD) se chalo, 💰 loot uthao':!doorUsed?'🖐 Orange 🚪 door par TAP karke kholo':'🏃 Ab green EXIT tak jao!';
 if(li===1)return!hacked?'🖐 📹 Camera par TAP = 5 sec band. Phir jaldi andar jao':'⏱ 5 second hain! Jaldi 💰 uthao aur EXIT jao';
 if(li===2)return'⚠ Guard ki peeli roshni se bacho. Patrol dekho, guard door ho tab chalo';return L.tip;}

// ---------- drawing ----------
function drawThief(cx,cy,u,f,p){p=p||SK[prog.sk]||SK[0];const d=f*.5*u;ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.35)';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(cx,cy+4.3*u,3.6*u,1.2*u,0,0,7);ctx.fill();
 ctx.fillStyle=p.b;ctx.fillRect(cx-2.2*u,cy+2*u,1.8*u,2.3*u);ctx.fillRect(cx+.4*u,cy+2*u,1.8*u,2.3*u);
 ctx.fillStyle=p.g;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(cx-f*3.4*u,cy,1.8*u,0,7);ctx.fill();
 ctx.fillStyle=p.b;ctx.fillRect(cx-3*u,cy-1.6*u,6*u,4*u);ctx.fillStyle=p.st;for(let i=0;i<3;i++)ctx.fillRect(cx-3*u,cy-1.1*u+i*1.2*u,6*u,.5*u);
 ctx.fillStyle=p.k;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(cx,cy-3.2*u,2.5*u,0,7);ctx.fill();ctx.fillStyle=p.h;ctx.fillRect(cx-2.5*u,cy-4*u,5*u,1.4*u);ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(cx,cy-3.9*u,2.5*u,PI,0);ctx.fill();
 ctx.fillStyle=p.e||'#fff';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(cx-u+d,cy-3.3*u,.45*u,0,7);ctx.arc(cx+u+d,cy-3.3*u,.45*u,0,7);ctx.fill();}
function drawGuard(cx,cy,u,f){const d=f*.5*u;ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.35)';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(cx,cy+4.3*u,3.6*u,1.2*u,0,0,7);ctx.fill();
 ctx.fillStyle='#1b2f5e';ctx.fillRect(cx-2.2*u,cy+2*u,1.8*u,2.3*u);ctx.fillRect(cx+.4*u,cy+2*u,1.8*u,2.3*u);ctx.fillStyle='#2a4a8a';ctx.fillRect(cx-3*u,cy-1.6*u,6*u,4*u);
 ctx.fillStyle='#111';ctx.fillRect(cx-3*u,cy+.9*u,6*u,.6*u);ctx.fillStyle='#ffd600';ctx.fillRect(cx-.3*u,cy-1.2*u,.6*u,.6*u);ctx.fillRect(cx-.3*u,cy-.1*u,.6*u,.6*u);
 ctx.fillStyle='#f2c9a0';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(cx,cy-3.2*u,2.5*u,0,7);ctx.fill();ctx.fillStyle='#111';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(cx-u+d,cy-3.1*u,.45*u,0,7);ctx.arc(cx+u+d,cy-3.1*u,.45*u,0,7);ctx.fill();
 ctx.fillStyle='#1b2f5e';ctx.fillRect(cx-2.6*u,cy-5.9*u,5.2*u,2.2*u);ctx.fillRect(cx-3*u,cy-4*u,6*u,.8*u);ctx.fillStyle='#ffd600';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(cx,cy-4.9*u,.7*u,0,7);ctx.fill();}
function drawLoot(cx,cy,s){const g=ctx.createRadialGradient(cx,cy,0,cx,cy,s*1.1);g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,214,0,.4)');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,214,0,0)');ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(cx-s*1.2,cy-s*1.2,s*2.4,s*2.4);
 ctx.fillStyle='#c9a227';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(cx,cy+s*.1,s*.5,0,7);ctx.fill();ctx.fillStyle='#8d6e0f';ctx.fillRect(cx-s*.2,cy-s*.45,s*.4,s*.2);ctx.fillStyle='#4a3a05';ctx.font=`bold ${s*.6}px system-ui`;ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText('$',cx,cy+s*.3);}
function cone(x,y,a,len,hf,rgb){const X=ox+x*T,Y=oy+y*T,g=ctx.createRadialGradient(X,Y,0,X,Y,len*T);g.addColorStop(0,`rgba(${rgb},.55)`);g.addColorStop(1,`rgba(${rgb},.06)`);ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(X,Y);
 for(let i=0;i<=14;i++){const aa=a-hf+hf*2*i/14,d=ray(x,y,aa,len);ctx.lineTo(ox+(x+Math.cos(aa)*d)*T,oy+(y+Math.sin(aa)*d)*T);}ctx.fill();}
function sky(){const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);g.addColorStop(0,'#0b1020');g.addColorStop(1,'#241552');ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
 ctx.fillStyle='#f5f0c8';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(W*.8,H*.18,H*.07,0,7);ctx.fill();
 for(let i=0;i<14;i++){const bw=W/14,bh=H*(.18+((i*37)%11)/40);ctx.fillStyle='#121a36';ctx.fillRect(i*bw,H*.82-bh,bw-2,bh+H*.2);ctx.fillStyle='#ffd54f66';for(let k=0;k<bh/(H*.05);k++)if((i*7+k*3)%4<2)ctx.fillRect(i*bw+bw*.25,H*.82-bh+k*H*.05+4,bw*.15,H*.025);}
 for(let k=0;k<2;k++){const X=W*(.25+.5*k),a=PI/2+Math.sin(now*.8+k*2)*.5,g=ctx.createLinearGradient(X,0,X+Math.cos(a)*H,Math.sin(a)*H);g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,240,150,.4)');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,240,150,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(X,0);ctx.lineTo(X+Math.cos(a-.12)*H*1.2,Math.sin(a-.12)*H*1.2);ctx.lineTo(X+Math.cos(a+.12)*H*1.2,Math.sin(a+.12)*H*1.2);ctx.fill();}
 ctx.fillStyle='#0a0f22';ctx.fillRect(0,H*.82,W,H*.2);
 const u=H/45;ctx.save();drawThief(W*.2,H*.74+Math.sin(now*3)*3,u*1.6,1);drawGuard(W*.82,H*.74,u*1.6,-1);drawLoot(W*.5,H*.76,u*5);ctx.restore();}
function drawGame(){const ao=ctx.globalAlpha;ctx.fillStyle='#0b1020';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);ctx.save();if(shake>0)ctx.translate((Math.random()-.5)*shake*14,(Math.random()-.5)*shake*14);
 for(let y=0;y<R;y++)for(let x=0;x<C;x++){const ch=MAP[y][x];if(ch==='#')continue;ctx.fillStyle=(x+y)%2?'#182034':'#1c2439';ctx.fillRect(ox+x*T,oy+y*T,T+.5,T+.5);
  if(y>0&&MAP[y-1][x]==='#'){const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,oy+y*T,0,oy+y*T+T*.5);g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(0,0,0,.45)');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(ox+x*T,oy+y*T,T,T*.5);}}
 for(let y=0;y<R;y++)for(let x=0;x<C;x++){const ch=MAP[y][x],X=ox+x*T,Y=oy+y*T;
  if(ch==='D'){const o=(doorT[x+','+y]||0)>t;ctx.fillStyle=o?'#1d4d4a66':'#ff9800';ctx.fillRect(X+T*.08,Y+T*.08,T*.84,T*.84);if(!o){ctx.fillStyle='#e65100';for(let k=0;k<4;k++)ctx.fillRect(X+T*.08,Y+T*.14+k*T*.22,T*.84,T*.08);ctx.fillStyle='#ffd180';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(X+T*.5,Y+T*.5,T*.12,0,7);ctx.fill();
   if(st==='play'){ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(0,229,255,${.5+.4*Math.sin(now*6)})`;ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(X+T*.5,Y+T*.5,T*.62,0,7);ctx.stroke();}}}
  if(ch==='E'){const on=loot.size===0,p=.5+.5*Math.sin(now*5);ctx.fillStyle=on?`rgba(105,240,174,${.5+.3*p})`:'#2e5a44';ctx.fillRect(X+3,Y+3,T-6,T-6);ctx.fillStyle=on?'#1b5e3b':'#1d3b2c';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(X+T*.5,Y+T*.2);ctx.lineTo(X+T*.8,Y+T*.55);ctx.lineTo(X+T*.6,Y+T*.55);ctx.lineTo(X+T*.6,Y+T*.8);ctx.lineTo(X+T*.4,Y+T*.8);ctx.lineTo(X+T*.4,Y+T*.55);ctx.lineTo(X+T*.2,Y+T*.55);ctx.fill();}}
 for(let y=0;y<R;y++)for(let x=0;x<C;x++)if(MAP[y][x]==='#'){const X=ox+x*T,Y=oy+y*T,h=T*.22;ctx.fillStyle='#46558a';ctx.fillRect(X,Y-h,T+.5,T);if(y+1>=R||MAP[y+1][x]!=='#'){ctx.fillStyle='#232d52';ctx.fillRect(X,Y+T-h,T+.5,h);}
  ctx.fillStyle='#5a6ba6';ctx.fillRect(X,Y-h,T+.5,2);}
 loot.forEach(k=>{const[a,b]=k.split(',').map(Number);drawLoot(ox+(a+.5)*T,oy+(b+.5)*T+Math.sin(now*3+a)*T*.04,T*.5);});
 cams.forEach(c=>{if(c.off<=t)cone(c.x,c.y,c.a,c.len,.3,'255,50,70');});guards.forEach(g=>cone(g.x,g.y,g.a,3.8,.7,'255,170,0'));
 cams.forEach(c=>{const X=ox+c.x*T,Y=oy+c.y*T,on=c.off<=t;ctx.fillStyle='#37474f';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(X,Y,T*.17,0,7);ctx.fill();ctx.save();ctx.translate(X,Y);ctx.rotate(c.a);ctx.fillStyle='#cfd8dc';ctx.fillRect(-T*.1,-T*.17,T*.5,T*.34);
  ctx.fillStyle=on?'#ff3d57':'#555';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(T*.4,0,T*.13,0,7);ctx.fill();ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(T*.43,-T*.04,T*.04,0,7);ctx.fill();ctx.restore();
  if(st==='play'){ctx.strokeStyle=c.ready<=t?`rgba(0,229,255,${.6+.3*Math.sin(now*6)})`:'#666';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(X,Y,T*(.6+.06*Math.sin(now*6)),0,7);ctx.stroke();
   if(c.ready>t){ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.font=`bold ${T*.4}px system-ui`;ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText(Math.ceil(c.ready-t),X,Y-T*.8);}}});
 guards.forEach(g=>drawGuard(ox+g.x*T,oy+g.y*T,T/10,Math.cos(g.a)<0?-1:1));
 if(!(inv>0&&Math.floor(t*10)%2))drawThief(ox+th.x*T,oy+th.y*T,T/10,fdir);
 parts.forEach(p=>{ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,p.l);ctx.fillStyle=p.c;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(ox+p.x*T,oy+p.y*T,T*.07,0,7);ctx.fill();});ctx.globalAlpha=1;ctx.restore();
 if(vig){ctx.fillStyle=vig;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);}
 if(flash>0){ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(255,0,0,${flash*.35})`;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);}
 if(touchUI&&st==='play'){const j=joy||{cx:T*3,cy:H-T*3,r:T*1.8,x:T*3,y:H-T*3};ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.12)';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(j.cx,j.cy,j.r,0,7);ctx.fill();ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.35)';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(j.x,j.y,j.r*.4,0,7);ctx.fill();}}
function resize(f){const d=window.devicePixelRatio||1,nw=cv.clientWidth||innerWidth,nh=cv.clientHeight||innerHeight;if(nw<50||nh<50||(!f&&nw===W&&nh===H))return;
 W=nw;H=nh;cv.width=W*d;cv.height=H*d;ctx.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0);hud=Math.max(34,H*.07);
 if(C){T=Math.min(W/C,(H-hud-(li<3?44:0))/R);ox=(W-T*C)/2;oy=hud+(H-hud-T*R)/2-(li<3?10:0);}
 vig=ctx.createRadialGradient(W/2,H/2,Math.min(W,H)*.35,W/2,H/2,Math.max(W,H)*.75);vig.addColorStop(0,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');vig.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,.55)');}
addEventListener('resize',()=>resize());if(window.ResizeObserver)new ResizeObserver(()=>resize()).observe(document.documentElement);
function frame(dt){update(dt);
 if(st==='home'||st==='sel'||st==='how')sky();else{drawGame();
  if(st==='play'||st==='pause'||st==='intro'){$('h1').textContent=`Lvl ${li+1}: ${L.n}`;$('h2').textContent=`💰 ${total-loot.size}/${total}   ⏱ ${t.toFixed(0)}s`;$('h3').textContent='❤'.repeat(Math.max(0,lives));if(st==='play')$('hint').textContent=hint();}}}
$('snd').textContent=muted?'SOUND OFF':'SOUND ON';coinUI();show('home');
let last=performance.now();(function loop(n){if(!W)resize();else{const dt=Math.min((n-last)/1000,.033);last=n;frame(dt);}requestAnimationFrame(loop);})(last);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
